text:
Intruder alarms, mobile phones and security scanners are practical uses of
electromagnetic radiation.
Which list places the devices in the correct order of increasing wavelength of the electromagnetic
radiation used?
intruder alarms → mobile phones → security scanners
A
mobile phones → intruder alarms → security scanners
B
security scanners → intruder alarms → mobile phones
C
security scanners → mobile phones → intruder alarms
D

options.label: A
options.text: intruder alarms → mobile phones → security scanners

options.label: B
options.text: mobile phones → intruder alarms → security scanners

options.label: C
options.text: security scanners → intruder alarms → mobile phones

options.label: D
options.text: security scanners → mobile phones → intruder alarms
